List the URLs reachable from a starting page, without fetching any content. `url` and `limit` are both required (limit 1 to 100000). Returns `success`, a request `id`, and `links[]` with `url` and `title` — note these are **objects with a title**, unlike [`post_tavily_map`](/api-reference/search/post_tavily-map) which returns bare strings. Measured at about 9 seconds. Billed 1 credit per discovered link, so `limit` is a cost control, not just a page control. Use it to size a site before paying to crawl it, then fetch only what matters with [`post_firecrawl_scrape`](/api-reference/search/post_firecrawl-scrape). When you want content and structure in one pass, [`post_firecrawl_crawl`](/api-reference/search/post_firecrawl-crawl).

**Billing: per call (1 credit per lookup).** Current prices are on [aisa.one/api](https://aisa.one/api). The "not registered" **HTTP 404** result returns a valid JSON body and is still billed 1 credit; only 429, 5xx, and network errors are not billed. (A **400** validation error is a client-side rejection.)

Set to true to download the video/images and get back permanent Supabase URLs. Costs 10 credits if media is found, 1 credit otherwise.

Paid opt-in, enabled only by the literal query value 'true' (allow_long_transcription=true). Defaults to false when omitted; other values do not enable paid mode. By default, successful AI transcription of videos up to 120 seconds (two minutes, inclusive) costs a flat 1 credit per request. Over 120 seconds, videos cannot be AI-transcribed by default. Set allow_long_transcription=true to opt into paid AI with no fixed duration cap: ALL successful AI transcriptions in this mode cost 10 credits per started minute, including short videos: 10 * ceil(duration_seconds / 60). For example, 177 seconds costs 30 credits and an opted-in 60 seconds costs 10 credits. Empty AI results and errors cost 0 credits for AI transcription. This flag does not force AI and does not enable transcription or AI fallback by itself. Keep get_transcript=true or use_ai_as_fallback=true where required by the endpoint. Returned native captions still cost 1 credit on dedicated transcript routes, even for long videos with this flag; on detail routes they leave the base price unchanged. These routes remain synchronous. Allow at least 30 seconds on your client. Paid long transcription can exceed resource limits or timeouts, so successful transcription of long videos is not guaranteed.

Provider reference (supplier schema): `{"default":false,"type":"boolean"}`.
